Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players |
|-----|-----------------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑1980s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short loan), *David Thompson* (trade), *Bobby Phills* |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton* (first All-Star with the team), *Danny Manning*, *Julius Erving* (short stint), *Chris Webber* (trade), *P.J. Brown* |
| **2000s** | *Steve Nash* (two seasons), *Derek Fisher* (mid‑season trade), *Jamal Crawford* (key role), *Julius Randle* (early career), *DeAndre Jordan* (rookie season) |
| **2010s** | *Chris Paul* (2011‑12 season), *Blake Griffin* (2011‑12 season), *Paul George* (2012‑13 season), *Kawhi Leonard* (2012‑13 season), *Reggie Jackson* (2015‑16 season), *Julius Randle* (2017‑18 season) |
| **Recent Years (2018‑2026)** | *Paul George* (return 2021‑22), *Kawhi Leonard* (2021‑22), *Russell Westbrook* (2021‑22), *Anthony Davis* (2022‑23), *Luka Dončić* (2023‑24), *Ja Morant* (2024‑25), *Trae Young* (2025‑26), *Carmelo Anthony* (2025‑26) |
